title: Cosmetics Business review: what we learned at Sephora's UK beauty festival Sephoria
summary: Team Cosmetics Business was on the ground at the LVMH-owned retailer’s Sephoria beauty festival this weekend, which took place in the UK for the very first time. Read our review of Sephora’s large-scale experience and what we think it offered beauty lovers
